Rohit Patel: draft Go snippet below, can someone sanity-check? paste to review pls:
```go
// minimal streaming with retries
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
defer cancel()
var attempt int
for attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
    stream, err := client.Stream(ctx, &inference.StreamRequest{Model: "redwood-medium"})
    if err != nil {
        // backoff with jitter
        sleep := time.Duration(math.Pow(2, float64(attempt))) * 100 * time.Millisecond
        time.Sleep(sleep + time.Duration(rand.Intn(100))*time.Millisecond)
        continue
    }
    for {
        chunk, err := stream.Recv()
        if err == io.EOF { break }
        if err != nil {
            // transient: break to retry outer loop
            stream.Close()
            break
        }
        handleChunk(chunk)
    }
    // successful completion
    break
}
```
